import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class F {
        long v;

        F(long x) {
            v = x % MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            if (v >= MOD) {
                System.err.println("F error");
                System.exit(1);
            }
        }

        F add(F o) {
            return new F((v + o.v) % MOD);
        }

        F sub(F o) {
            return new F((v - o.v + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        F mul(F o) {
            return new F((v * o.v) % MOD);
        }

        F div(F o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        void addEq(F o) {
            v = (v + o.v) % MOD;
        }

        void subEq(F o) {
            v = (v - o.v + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        void mulEq(F o) {
            v = (v * o.v) % MOD;
        }

        void divEq(F o) {
            mulEq(o.inv());
        }

        F inv() {
            long e = MOD - 2;
            long b = v;
            long r = 1;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                    r = (r * b) % MOD;
                }
                b = (b * b) % MOD;
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return new F(r);
        }
    }

    static F[][] mul(F[][] A, F[][] B) {
        int n = A.length;
        int m = A[0].length;
        int p = B[0].length;
        if (B.length != m) {
            System.err.println("mul dim error");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        F[][] C = new F[n][p];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = new F(0);
                for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                    C[i][j].v = (C[i][j].v + A[i][k].v * B[k][j].v) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static F[] mul(F[][] A, F[] x) {
        int n = A.length;
        int m = A[0].length;
        if (x.length != m) {
            System.err.println("mat-vec dim error");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        F[] y = new F[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            y[i] = new F(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                y[i].v = (y[i].v + A[i][j].v * x[j].v) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return y;
    }

    static F[][] mat2D(int r, int c) {
        F[][] result = new F[r][c];
        for (int i = 0; i < r; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < c; ++j) {
                result[i][j] = new F(0);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static F[][][] mat3D(int a, int b, int c) {
        F[][][] result = new F[a][b][c];
        for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < b; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < c; ++k) {
                    result[i][j][k] = new F(0);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        F[][][] S = mat3D(d, d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                S[k][i][(i + k) % d].v = 1;
            }
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            S[k][d][d].v = 1;
        }

        F[][][] U = mat3D(d, d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
                U[k][i][i].v = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
                U[k][k][i].v = 1;
            }
        }

        F[][] I = mat2D(d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
            I[i][i].v = 1;
        }

        Map<Long, F[][]> dp = new HashMap<>();

        class Solver {
            F[][] solve(long p) {
                if (dp.containsKey(p)) {
                    return dp.get(p);
                }
                if (p <= d) {
                    F[][] M = new F[d + 1][d + 1];
                    for (int i = 0; i <= d; ++i) {
                        for (int j = 0; j <= d; ++j) {
                            M[i][j] = new F(I[i][j].v);
                        }
                    }
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; ++k) {
                        M = mul(U[k], M);
                    }
                    dp.put(p, M);
                    return M;
                }
                long block = d;
                while ((p + block - 1) / block > d) {
                    block *= d;
                }
                F[][] child = solve(block);
                F[][] M = new F[d + 1][d + 1];
                for (int i = 0; i <= d; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; ++j) {
                        M[i][j] = new F(child[i][j].v);
                    }
                }
                long rem = p - block;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; ++k) {
                    if (rem >= block) {
                        M = mul(mul(mul(S[d - k], child), S[k]), M);
                        rem -= block;
                    } else if (rem > 0) {
                        M = mul(mul(mul(S[d - k], solve(rem)), S[k]), M);
                        rem = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                dp.put(p, M);
                return M;
            }
        }

        Solver solver = new Solver();
        F[][] M = solver.solve(n);
        F[] base = new F[d + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
            base[i] = new F(0);
        }
        base[d] = new F(1);
        F[] ansVec = mul(M, base);
        F sum = new F(0);
        for (F x : ansVec) {
            sum.v = (sum.v + x.v) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(sum.v);
    }
}
